newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOSHIBA CERAMICS TO SELL QUARTZ PRODUCTS FOR CHIPS.
newsitem.headline: TOSHIBA CERAMICS TO SELL QUARTZ PRODUCTS FOR CHIPS.

text.p: Toshiba Ceramics Co Ltd said on Thursday that it would start selling ultra-pure quartz products for use in the production of next-generation dynamic random access memory (DRAM) chips.

The quartz products would help raise production yields of 256-megabit and one-gigabit DRAM chips when they are used in semiconductor manufacturing equipment to process wafers, the company said in a statement.
Toshiba Ceramics said it had started mass-production of these quartz products at its newly completed plant in Yamagata prefecture. It did not give a production volume.
